closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: Incomplete prepare has no durable resume journal or per-stock completion receipts; root selection defaults to another attempt and repeats CSV work.
expected: Resume original operation and SOURCE; adopt native same-operation closed CSVs with explicit bounded readback and signatures, retain verified index component, process only unfinished instruments, never invent PASS for partial output or repeat historical export.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
root_cause: The native monthly runner saved its resume record only after all prepare components returned. Closed per-stock CSVs and a fully verified native index therefore existed without a prepare checkpoint after a later stock failed. A retry selected a fresh staging directory, while the CSV preparer rejected any existing root. This caused unnecessary recomputation of already correct month output, not missing upstream facts.
fix_summary: Persist the existing monthly data binding before prepare, retain its original materialization attempt, and recover legacy partial preparation only when the native index receipt binds exactly the same SOURCE/cutoff/predecessor. Existing CSVs acquire per-file completion receipts with native hashes/signatures, and completed stock codes are excluded before canonical transformation and sealed source merge. Retain construction files unchanged; verify/reuse the completed native index. Use the existing native canonical writer and patch receipt schema. No new release branch, SOURCE collection, business policy, dependency, approval or publication gate.

fresh_process_evidence: RED: daily and minute retry fix points both failed with an existing private CSV directory before implementation. GREEN: both pass without invoking the canonical transformer again or changing completed file mtimes. A two-stock interrupted-minute integration passed: 240 closed bars reused, only the remaining stock selected for raw minute reading, 240 bars newly transformed, 480 total. Identity mismatch, non-finite/truncated/unknown legacy CSV, altered bytes, unchanged bytes with mtime-only change, exact missing-file recovery and no-reparse retry regressions pass.

One final related matrix passed 264 tests across monthly resume, legacy build, native CSV materializer and mature build runner. A subsequent targeted hard-kill fragment test passed; incomplete native CSV and metadata fragments are retained privately, not counted as completed or published. No repeated broad matrix was run. Changed-file Ruff, diff check and L0 are required before PR readiness.

Fresh-process DEV proof used small same-volume hardlinks to original attempt18 CSVs, never copied or modified original bytes. It reused 34 daily rows and 8160 minute rows for 000001.SZ and 301716.SZ; a second retry forbade parsing and still passed. Original signatures remained identical. X:/AIstock_temp/DATA_PREPARATION/monthly-october-release-20261030/BUG-2170-native-csv-dev-readback.json. database_access=false, network_access=false, original_candidate_write=false, profile_write=false, runtime_action=false. Only DEV metadata was written; this is not a complete candidate readiness claim.

Review 1: same operation/SOURCE/cutoff/predecessor binding and no overwrite/re-export of completed native outputs. Review 2: factual population and PIT eligibility remain separate, units/QFQ/session/strict missing-value semantics are unchanged, only unfinished codes enter the transform, mismatched bytes remain errors. Review 3: per-stock durability, exact missing-file regeneration, metadata-only change readback, bounded one-time legacy CSV adoption, and preservation of uncommitted crash fragments. Existing index files use their original native receipt signatures, not a historical rescan. Review 4: CI41337992339 passed 2377 tests with87 skips and exposed one private-preparation repeat-call compatibility regression. Recovery is now limited to formal legacy monthly BUILD; private/other preparation retains its original already-exists exception and never adopts release progress. Rerun only that failing node locally, then rely on the required CI rerun. Native completed-index fix-point also verified all14 stored signatures, 12 indices and204 October rows without data writes (BUG-2170-native-index-reuse.json).

DESIGN-COMPLIANCE-001 PASS: native end-to-end fix points rather than a POC or whole-release completion claim; no fake PASS/READY, fallback or invented source data; no unapproved business/PIT migration; no new manual approval, resource or historical audit gate. Production DDL/DML, activation, training, experiment and process control remain false. SOURCE version21 and its sealed bundle 9834867ae964e20128c1b52f35ca69b6b75dc321d6dbd99be04c432bef8db711 are unchanged. Runtime loading and complete October candidate/deployment/consumer validation remain separate pending steps.
